line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

verification.scope: Compared pinned and current source, paired exclusion structure, and previous actual compiler controls recorded under R2089 and R2102. No product edit or new runtime test.

decision: R2089: the SDK memory macros expand inside the original function prototypes on x64. R2102: public SDK process parameters, message resources and OS version structures already own the tags; the two private process information layouts embed missing SECTION_IMAGE_INFORMATION types by value. A forward declaration cannot supply their sizes. Retain the recorded omissions.
